summary: The WhatsApp readiness verdict no longer stays degraded on a failed canonical owner notice when the connected channel itself reports a later send (channels status « out: … ago »).
reason: S24 29/10: the network came back at 08:47 (Tunis); the incident recovery notice failed on WhatsApp at 08:48:32 and went by email; the channel sent at 08:51 but nothing newer reached health/whatsapp-outbound.log, so notification.whatsapp stayed degraded (latest_outbound_failed) for hours while connected.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-whatsapp-channel-health.py
tests.evidence: S24 29/10 status line (numbers removed) with out:43m ago at 09:34:30 and the 08:48:32 failure: healthy; a send older than the failure, no out: field, or a failure without timestamp: still degraded; out:<1m ago: healthy.

capabilities.reason: Same health component and evidence; a later channel send now supersedes an older failed notice.

architecture.reason: Same verdict owner; no new store, probe or notifier.

evidence: Health verdict of the WhatsApp notification channel only.

limitations: Full canonical CI on the final GitHub head remains required.
Relies on the « out: … ago » field of openclaw channels status (OpenClaw 2026.9.6); without it the previous rule applies.
